activity.notes: Ryu Seong-ryong served as Chief State Councillor and concurrently as Four-Province Chechalsa from October 1595 until spring 1598. ATLAS stores the interval at year granularity.

sources.title: 군문등록
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture states that Ryu Seong-ryong served from October 1595 to spring 1598 as Chief State Councillor and Four-Province Chechalsa.
